method: Computed directly via npx tsx importing getAllSoftware(), PUBLISHED_COMPARISONS, and ALTERNATIVE_GUIDES (data/software, data/comparisons.ts, data/seo/alternative-guides.ts) -- not regex-parsed. Sources counted: alt_in (times a slug appears in another product's alternatives[] array), cmp_in (times a slug appears in a PUBLISHED_COMPARISONS pair), guide_in (times a slug appears as a decision.alternativeSlug inside ALTERNATIVE_GUIDES). Confirmed components/Navbar.tsx and components/Footer.tsx add zero per-product links, so these counts are directly comparable to scripts/growth/internal-link-graph-v2.ts's own model.

weaklyLinkedActivePartners.distributionNote: N=354, min=0, Q1(25th percentile)=6, median=11, max=33 (notion). All 22 active partners are catalogued.
weaklyLinkedActivePartners.finding: 5 of 22 active affiliate partners sit at or below the bottom quartile of internal-link strength, and none of the five has an ALTERNATIVE_GUIDES entry -- meaning none benefits from the highest-value link mechanism on the site (the 88 real 'Explore {product}' links). This is a genuine, evidenced mismatch between architecture and commercial priority, ahead of already-well-linked partners like todoist (22) or monday (22).
weaklyLinkedActivePartners.mechanicalCorrectionVerifiedThisSession: An ALTERNATIVE_GUIDES entry keyed to product X sends inbound links to the ALTERNATIVES X's guide names, not to X itself. Fixing Volza's own weak count requires some OTHER product's guide to name Volza as a decision option, not a new 'volza:' guide entry. Volza's only existing comparison (volza-vs-google-analytics) is also a weak categorical fit (global trade-intelligence software vs. general web analytics) -- forcing a guide entry around it would be a low-quality fix, not a real one. The other four (Jotform, MailerLite, Omnisend, SurveyMonkey) sit in more natural, competitive SaaS categories (forms, email marketing, surveys) with better-fitting existing comparisons (e.g. surveymonkey-vs-jotform) and are the more promising next targets -- but the correct fix in each case is identifying which OTHER product's guide should route to them, not writing a guide for themselves. Not executed this session to avoid a mechanically confused or rushed low-quality change; queued as a well-scoped Tier A item in remaining-opportunities.md.
